mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity; sumatriptan acts as a 5-HT1B/1D agonist while atomoxetine inhibits norepinephrine reuptake with some serotonergic effects, creating potential for serotonin syndrome.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia); this combination is generally acceptable but caution is warranted, particularly with dose escalation.
